questions.question: A sum of Rs. 4000 is lent on simple interest at the rate of 10% per annum. Simple interest for 5 years is how much more than the simple interest for 3 years?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A sum of Rs.4000 is lent on simple interest at the rate of 10% per annum

P= 4000

R = 10%

**Formula used:**

S.I = (P × N × R)/100

**Calculation:**

S.I for 5 years = (4000 × 5 × 10)/100 = 2000

S.I for 3 years = (4000 × 3 × 10)/100 = 1200

⇒ Difference between S.I for 5 years and S.I for 3 years = 2000 - 1200 = 800

**∴ Simple interest for 5 years is 800 more than the simple interest for 3 years.**

questions.question: Marked price of an article is ₹ 8840. If discount of 35% is given on the article, then what will be the selling price of the article?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

M.P = 8840

Discount = 35%

**Formula used:**

Selling Price, S.P = Marked Price, M.P - Discount

**Calculation:**

M.P = 8840

Discount = 35% of M.P 

⇒ (35/100) × 8840 = 3094

S.P = M. P - Discount

⇒ S.P = 8840 - 3094 = 5746

∴ Selling Price of the article = ₹ 5746

questions.question: Product of Highest Common Factor and Least Common Multiple of two numbers is 216. If one of the number is 12, then what will be the ratio of these two numbers?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Product of HCF and LCM of two numbers = 216

One of the numbers = 12

**Concept:**

Product of the numbers = HCF × LCM

**Calculation:**

Let the numbers to be found be N

12 × N = 216

⇒ N = 216/12 = 18

The two numbers are 12 and 18

∴ The Ratio of these two numbers = 12 : 18 = 2 : 3

questions.question: Three cubes each of sides 7 cm are joined end to end. Find the surface area of the resulting solid.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Three cubes each of sides 7 cm are joined end to end

**Concept:**

When 3 cubes of same side are joined end to end, the resulting solid will be a cuboid

**Formula used:**

Surface area of Cuboid = 2 × ((l × b) + (l × h) + (b × h))

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/704bcd6f452196010494f01f0fe7e98a56efb8ed7c7cb97cf890d718141a4a12.png] 

Length of the Cuboid, l = 7 + 7 + 7 = 21 cm

Breadth of the Cuboid, b = Same as the side of the given Cube = 7 cm

Height of the Cuboid, h = Same as the side of the given Cube = 7 cm

Now,

Surface area of Cuboid = 2 × ((l × b) + (l × h) + (b × h))

⇒ S.A = 2 × ((21 × 7) + (21 × 7) + (7 × 7))

⇒ S.A = 2 × (147 + 147 + 49) = 686

∴ The surface area of the resulting solid = 686 cm²

questions.question: If 40% of a number is 105 more than the one-fourth of that number, then what will be the difference between the number and 35% of the number?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

40% of a number is 105 more than the one-fourth of that number

**Calculation:**

Let the number be X

40% of a number is 105 more than the one-fourth of that number

⇒ (40/100) × X = (X/4) + 105

⇒ (2/5) × X = (X + 420)/4

⇒ 8X = 5X + (5 × 420)

⇒ 3X = 2100

∴ X = 700

Now,

35% of the number = (35/100) × 700

⇒ 35% of the number = 245

∴ The difference between the number and 35% of the number = 700 - 245 = 455

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

40% of a number - one-fourth of that number(25%) = 105

⇒ 15% = 105 .....(i)

difference between the number(100%) and 35% of the number = 100% - 35% = 65%

using (i) we have 

65% = 60% + 5% = (105 × 4 + 105/3) = 420 + 35 = 455

questions.question: Anil, Dinesh and Deepak together can complete a work in 40 days. Anil and Dinesh together can complete the same work in 50 days. In how many days Deepak alone can complete the same work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Anil, Dinesh and Deepak together can complete a work in 40 days

Anil and Dinesh together can complete the same work in 50 days

**Formula used: **

Number of days = Total work/1 day work

**Calculation:**

Let x, y, and z represents Anil, Dinesh, and Deepak respectively

x + y + z → 40 days

x + y → 50 days

Total work = LCM (40, 50) = 200 unit

∴ (x + y + z)'s 1 day work = 200/40 = 5 unit

And, (x + y)'s 1 day work = 200/50 = 4 unit

⇒ z's 1 day work = 5 - 4 = 1 unit

∴ Number of days z alone can complete the same work = 200/1 = 200 days

Number of days Deepak alone can complete the same work = 200 days

questions.question: P alone can complete a work in 16 days and Q alone can complete the same work in 20 days. P and Q start the work together but Q leaves the work 7 days before the completion of work. In how many days the total work will be completed?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

P alone can complete a work in 16 days

Q alone can complete the same work in 20 days

P and Q start the work together but Q leaves the work 7 days before the completion of work

**Formula used:**

Number of days = Total work/1 day's work

**Calculation:**

P → 16 days

Q → 20 days

Total work = LCM (20, 16) = 80 unit

1 day work of P = 80/16 = 5 unit

1 day work of Q = 80/20 = 4 unit

Now,

P and Q start the work together but Q leaves the work 7 days before the completion of work

(P + Q)'s one day's work = 5 + 4 = 9 unit

Let number of days to complete the Total work be x

⇒ (9 × (x - 7)) + (5 × 7) = 80

⇒ (9x - 63) + 35 = 80

⇒ 9x = 108

∴ x= 108/9 = 12

**In 12 days the total work will be completed.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f72be33799c08d3322a2907949d25e7543e352bc7880a277f6efed7f62d7c04b.png] **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/525a636d810940ed457c9fd0c38fc521c2211b1672975c58ed2e2809d848a238.png] 

According to the question,

P and Q start the work together but Q leaves the work 7 days before the completion of work

Q work complete in 7 days = 4 × 7 = 28 unit

It means 28 unit work by P

Total work done by P and Q

⇒ Total work/efficiency per day both

⇒ (80 + 28)/(5 + 4)

⇒ 108/9 = 12 days

**∴** In 12 days the total work will be completed.

questions.question: A shopkeeper sells two articles, one of them with a profit of 10% for ₹ 1100 and another with a loss of 10% for ₹ 900. What will be the profit or loss percent?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Profit for 1st** **Article = 10%

S.P of 1st Article = 1100

Loss for 2ⁿd Article = 10%

S.P of 2ⁿd Article = 900

**Formula used:**

If an article is sold at a profit of a%, then:

SP = [(100 + a)/100] × CP

Also, if an article is sold at a loss of b%, then:

SP = [(100 – b)/100] × CP

**Calculation:**

So, CP of the first article = 1100/[(100 + 10)/100]

⇒ CP of the first article = 1100/1.1 = 1000

Similarly,

CP of the second article = 900/[(100 – 10)/100]

⇒ CP of the first article = 900/0.9 = 1000

Hence, the total CP of the two articles = 1000 + 1000 = 2000

Also, the total SP of the two articles = 1100 + 900 = 2000

Hence, SP = CP

**∴ There is no profit no loss in the overall transaction**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c81d566e5ea192de9d5648e25830914fae3332b89cce3e90812d076904146301.png] 

Total SP = 1100 + 900 = 2000

Total CP = 1100 × 100/110 + 900 × 100/90

Total CP = 2000 

CP = SP

**∴ No loss no profit in the overall transaction**

questions.question: A bag has ₹ 785 in the denomination of ₹ 2, ₹ 5 and ₹ 10 coins. The coins are in the ratio of 6 : 9 : 10. How many coins of ₹ 5 are in the bag?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

₹ 785 in the denomination of ₹ 2, ₹ 5 and ₹ 10 coins

The coins are in the ratio of 6 : 9 : 10

**Calculation:**

Let the number of coins of ₹ 2, ₹ 5 and ₹ 10 be 6x, 9x, and 10x respectively

⇒ (2 × 6x) + (5 × 9x) + (10 × 10x) = 785

⇒ 157x = 785

∴ x = 5

Number of coins of ₹ 5 = 9x = 9 × 5 = 45

**∴ 45 coins of ₹ 5 are in the bag**

questions.question: Raju purchased glasses at the rate of Rs. 15 per glass and sold them at the rate of Rs. 12 per glass. On selling 42 glasses, what will be the loss percentage?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Purchased glasses at the rate of Rs.15 per glass

Sold glasses at the rate of Rs.12 per glass

Number of glasses sold = 42

**Concept:**

If Selling Price is less than Cost Price, then there will be Loss

**Formula used:**

Loss = C.P - S.P

Loss% = (Loss/C.P) × 100

**Calculation:**

Rate of glass while purchasing = Rs.15 per glass

Cost Price for 42 glasses, C.P = 42 × 15 = Rs.630

Rate of glass while selling = Rs.12 per glass

Selling Price for 42 glasses, S.P = 42 × 12 = Rs.504

Loss = 630 - 504 = 126

∴ Loss% = (126/630) × 100 = 20%

questions.question: From solid cylinder with base diameter 14 cm and height 20 cm hemispherical parts were cut from both the ends of the cylinder. Find the volume of the resultant object?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

From solid cylinder with base diameter 14 cm and height 20 cm hemispherical parts were cut from both the ends of the cylinder

**Concept:**

Volume of the Resultant object = Volume of Cylinder - (2 × Volume of Hemispherical parts)

**Formula used:**

Volume of Cylinder = π × r² × h

Volume of Hemisphere = (2/3) × π × r³

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c352b2bea3b237aae781e1f19681b7b989cc6ad0f2d30fcdffe4c36cb8963f5f.png] 

Base diameter = 14 cm

⇒ Radius = 14/2 = 7 cm

Height of Cylinder = 20 cm

Now,

Volume of the Resultant object = π × r2 × h - (2 × (2/3) × π × r³)

⇒ π × 7² × 20 - ( 2 × (2/3) × π × 7³)

⇒ 980π - 1372π /3

⇒ (2940π -1372π)/3 = 1568π/3

⇒ (1568 × (22/7))/3 = 4928/3

∴ Volume of the Resultant object = 4928/3 cm³

questions.question: The difference between the simple interest and compound interest (interest is compounded half yearly) on a sum at the rate of 25% per annum for one year is ₹ 4375. What will be the principal?
questions.solution:

The difference between the simple interest and compound interest (interest is compounded half yearly) on a sum at the rate of 25% per annum for one year is ₹ 4375

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest = (P × N × R)/100

Compound Interest = [P(1 + (r/200))T] - P (for compounded half yearly)

**Calculation:**

Let P be the Principal,

S.I = (P × 1 × 25)/100 = P/4

C.I = [P(1 + (25/200))²] - P ( T = 2 ∵ compounded half yearly for 1 year)

⇒ C.I = 17P/64

Now, C.I - S.I = (17P/64) - (P/4) = P/64

⇒ P/64 = 4375

∴ P = 64 × 4375 = 280000
